$comment: EPUB import and export (feature 012): the File > Import and File > Export entries, File > Open's refusal of an EPUB, the import's and the export's messages, progress and summaries. Feature catalogue merged into en.json by i18n/index.ts.

importEpub.description: Make a new book from an EPUB book of any version up to 3.3: its chapters, notes and pictures come along, best effort

exportEpub.description: Write the book as a valid EPUB 3.3 file that older reading devices can open too

epub.openRefused: {{path}} is an EPUB book. File > Open takes FictionBook (FB2) books, FBD files and ZIP archives holding FB2 books; an EPUB book is imported with File > Import > EPUB File....
epub.notReady: This part of the EPUB support is still being built.
epub.exportDone: Exported to {{path}}: {{pages}} pages, {{pictures}} pictures, {{tables}} tables, {{notes}} notes.
epub.exportCancelled: The export was cancelled; no file was written.
epub.exportSummaryIntro: Not everything was carried over as written:

summary.stylesheetDropped: Stylesheet that is not CSS left out: {{detail}}
summary.idMadeUnique: Id used more than once, made unique in the file: {{detail}}

writeFailed.badName: A file name inside the EPUB is not valid.
writeFailed.targetIsSource: {{path}} is the book's own file; choose another name.
writeFailed.unknownToken: The export lost its file; try again.
writeFailed.ioError: The file could not be written.
